interval_note: Enclosing display intervals, not confidence intervals; missing fields are not zero.
limits: Current collected Seoul/Gyeonggi stock within 700m straight-line distance to actual line-specific stations; not walking time or historical opening effects.
Unknown approval dates remain in the denominator; household shares use only confirmed household totals, while complex shares retain missing household counts.
A complex can belong to multiple lines; line totals cannot be added into regional totals.
